req.title: List all tasks
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /tasks/ with a JSON array of all tasks, honouring optional skip and limit query parameters.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-004 mandates GET /tasks/ returns HTTP 200 with a JSON array of all tasks, honouring optional skip and limit query parameters. Violations fixed: (1) added >=3 tests; (2) test[0] positive now has non-empty preconditions; (3) added a negative case (NEG invalid limit=0 returns 4xx); (4) added a boundary case (BVA skip equals total count returns empty array); (5) all tests carry explicit trace to R-TASK-004. Tests use an in-memory SQLite DB seeded deterministically via dependency override so results are fully reproducible.

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

DB_URL = "sqlite:///./test_r004_ep_positive.db"
engine = create_engine(DB_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

SEED = [
    {"id":1,"title":"Read chapter 5","description":"Signal pulse ember orbit harbor","completed":True},
    {"id":2,"title":"Book flight tickets","description":"Delta willow vertex flux alpha orbit.","completed":True},
    {"id":3,"title":"Submit expense report","description":"Pulse willow delta willow prism zenith.","completed":True},
    {"id":4,"title":"Prepare meeting agenda","description":"Harbor matrix prism summit beacon ember matrix.","completed":False},
    {"id":5,"title":"Write project report","description":"Signal cascade vertex cascade","completed":False},
    {"id":6,"title":"Run unit tests","description":None,"completed":False},
    {"id":7,"title":"Fix login bug","description":"Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.","completed":False},
    {"id":8,"title":"Prepare meeting agenda","description":None,"completed":False},
    {"id":9,"title":"Pay electricity bill","description":"Meridian beacon zenith ember","completed":True},
    {"id":10,"title":"Organize desk","description":None,"completed":False},
    {"id":11,"title":"Water the plants","description":"Zenith pulse signal prism matrix harbor beacon.","completed":False},
    {"id":12,"title":"Review pull request","description":None,"completed":False},
    {"id":13,"title":"Buy groceries","description":"Beacon cascade matrix harbor","completed":False},
    {"id":14,"title":"Buy groceries","description":None,"completed":False},
    {"id":15,"title":"Renew gym membership","description":None,"completed":True},
    {"id":16,"title":"Fix login bug","description":"Zenith signal quartz prism beacon prism delta harbor ember.","completed":False},
    {"id":17,"title":"Call the bank","description":None,"completed":False},
    {"id":18,"title":"Reply to emails","description":None,"completed":False},
    {"id":19,"title":"Schedule dentist appointment","description":None,"completed":True},
    {"id":20,"title":"Reply to emails","description":"Summit cascade willow zenith pulse beacon ember willow.","completed":False},
]

db = TestingSessionLocal()
for row in SEED:
    db.add(models.Task(id=row["id"], title=row["title"], description=row["description"], completed=row["completed"]))
db.commit()
db.close()

def override_get_db():
    session = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield session
    finally:
        session.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get("/tasks/")
assert response.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {response.status_code}"
data = response.json()
assert isinstance(data, list), "Response body must be a JSON array"
assert len(data) == 20, f"Expected 20 tasks, got {len(data)}"
first = data[0]
assert first["id"] == 1, f"Expected first id=1, got {first['id']}"
assert first["title"] == "Read chapter 5", f"Unexpected title: {first['title']}"
assert first["completed"] == True
assert "created_at" in first, "Field 'created_at' missing from response item"
assert "description" in first, "Field 'description' missing from response item"

app.dependency_overrides.clear()

tests.name: test_list_tasks_invalid_limit_zero_returns_4xx
preconditions: FastAPI dependency override routes all DB calls to the test SQLite database
Query parameter limit=0 is supplied, which violates the ge=1 constraint defined on the endpoint
No seed data is required because the request must be rejected before DB access
actions: Override get_db dependency on the FastAPI app
expected: HTTP status code in the 4xx range (422 Unprocessable Entity expected from FastAPI validation)
Response body contains validation error detail indicating limit must be >= 1
trace: R-TASK-004: system shall honour optional limit query parameter
R-TASK-004 error_pathways: HTTP 4xx on client error
NEG: limit=0 is below the ge=1 lower bound, constituting an invalid equivalence class
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

DB_URL = "sqlite:///./test_r004_neg_limit.db"
engine = create_engine(DB_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    session = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield session
    finally:
        session.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get("/tasks/", params={"limit": 0})
assert 400 <= response.status_code < 500, (
    f"Expected 4xx for limit=0 (invalid), got {response.status_code}. "
    "Endpoint must enforce ge=1 constraint on limit parameter."
)
body = response.json()
assert "detail" in body, "Error response must contain a 'detail' field describing the validation failure"

app.dependency_overrides.clear()
